name: Memory Library
description: The full programme: exhibitions, artworks, talks, workshops, screenings, performances and exchange exploring memory, place, heritage, technology and connection.

name: Resonate
description: Play Office's artist development programme. Work made through Resonate runs throughout Memory Library.

name: Past Makes Future
description: An international artist conference and gathering, plus Pageant — a separate evening event on the same day.

name: We Shine
description: Memory Library becomes a new hub within We Shine, Portsmouth's light festival — the daytime exhibition continues while Boathouse 5 opens into the evening.

name: People Library
description: A recurring participatory strand — people, not books, are the collection. Drop in and listen.
